lines.text: Many learners say: You are Ana, isn't it?
Better: You are Ana, aren't you?
The end must match the start.
Aren't you! You are Ana, aren't you?

data.why: The end must match the start.

en.tip: The end must match the start. Say aren't you. Say “You are Ana, aren't you?”
en.caption: Do you say “You are Ana, isn't it” in English? 😅 Korean can end with one word, but English matches the start of the sentence! “You are Ana, aren't you” is right. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
